recommendation: Keep the commit as-is for R6. It is limited to the CareTeam maturity metadata and the CareTeam-owned required status terminology; other co-listed maturity tickets should remain separate reconciliation work.
issue_request: FHIR-46581 asked to increase CareTeam resource maturity from its lower trial-use level; the Applied/Persuasive with Modification resolution says CareTeam is planned to go normative in R6 with FMM = 6.
initial_application: The combined branch had no Issue-Reconcile-Key: FHIR-46581 commit. Source history showed commit 5c20769 changed CareTeam standards-status from trial-use to normative, but current source still had CareTeam FMM 2 in source/fhir.ini and source/careteam/structuredefinition-CareTeam.xml, with the directly bound CareTeam.status CodeSystem and ValueSet also still at FMM 2.
additional_context: CareTeam is active in source/fhir.ini. The Jira resolution cites the September 2025 Patient Care WGM minutes, which discuss R6 normative resources and record a 31-0-1 motion supporting the documented feedback to FMG. The March 2026 Patient Care agenda and the Zulip maturity-comment thread show maturity tickets were handled based on the R6 normative intention; no exact CareTeam/FHIR-46581 Zulip conflict was found.
reconciliation: Changed source/fhir.ini careteam from 2 to 6, changed the CareTeam StructureDefinition fmm extension from 2 to 6, and changed the normative CareTeam status CodeSystem and ValueSet fmm extensions from 2 to 6.
source_changes: source/fhir.ini: changed the active CareTeam resource FMM entry from 2 to 6.
source/careteam/structuredefinition-CareTeam.xml: changed the CareTeam StructureDefinition structuredefinition-fmm extension from 2 to 6, preserving the existing normative standards-status.
source/careteam/codesystem-care-team-status.xml: changed the normative CareTeamStatus CodeSystem structuredefinition-fmm extension from 2 to 6.
source/careteam/valueset-care-team-status.xml: changed the normative CareTeamStatus ValueSet structuredefinition-fmm extension from 2 to 6.
